correctness.rationale: The Cox base-point conditions hold for every \(\varepsilon\). Three exact maximal minors of \(\Psi_{\varepsilon}\) prove rank three everywhere by an exhaustive projective case split, so the entire family is unramified. The source's reduced relative-cohomology block has determinant \(4096\varepsilon(1-4\varepsilon)\) and rank \(15\) at both roots. Since the normal bundle has rank two and degree \(12\), corank one is equivalent to \(\mathcal O(5)\oplus\mathcal O(7)\); invertibility gives \(\mathcal O(6)^{\oplus2}\). Both roots are simple. The bundled checker reconstructs the polynomial minors and reduced-block identities exactly.

value.rationale: The chosen affine line is not arbitrary: it is the canonical deformation used by the source to prove smoothness of its first explicit jump. Completing its geometry reveals exactly one additional unbalanced quartic, proves there are no other jumps on the line, and identifies the scheme-theoretic intersection with the jumping divisor as two reduced points. This converts a local transversality device into a complete natural slice of the newly constructed splitting stratification.
